rules.title: Dart 3.12 no longer receives security updates
rules.summary: The Dart security policy commits security updates only for the most recent stable SDK release. Dart 3.12 stopped being that release when Dart 3.13 shipped on 2026-08-12.

constraints: Keep environment.sdk in pubspec.yaml, the sdks block in pubspec.lock, the Flutter version pinned in .fvmrc, and the SDK used in CI on one supported release.
A Flutter project gets its Dart SDK from the Flutter release it pins, so raise the Flutter pin to a release that bundles the Dart version in the replacement instead of installing Dart on its own.

steps.title: Raise the SDK pin
steps.instructions: Change the reported Dart SDK pin to the version in the replacement. For a Flutter project, raise the Flutter version in .fvmrc or .fvm/fvm_config.json to a release that bundles that Dart version.

steps.title: Raise the SDK constraint
steps.instructions: Raise the lower bound of environment.sdk in pubspec.yaml (and environment.flutter for an app) so it admits only supported SDKs, then re-resolve dependencies so pubspec.lock records the new sdks constraints.

steps.title: Align CI and documentation
steps.instructions: Update CI workflows, Docker images, and setup documentation that install the Dart or Flutter SDK so they match the new pin.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Dart SDK is the intended release.
Re-resolve dependencies against the new SDK constraint.
Analyze and test a Flutter app on the new SDK.
Analyze and test a Dart package on the new SDK.

constraints: analysis_server_client wraps the analysis_server protocol, so replacing it changes the call sites and not only the dependency entry: migrate the pubspec declaration and the Dart code that imports the package together.
The publisher lists no replacement package on pub.dev, so choose a maintained fork or a direct implementation of the protocol before removing the dependency.

steps.title: Audit the client call sites
steps.instructions: List every file that imports package:analysis_server_client and the client, server, and protocol calls it makes.

steps.title: Choose a maintained replacement
steps.instructions: Pick a maintained fork or implement the analysis_server protocol directly, and confirm the choice supports the Dart SDK constraint in environment.sdk.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Update the imports and call sites, replace analysis_server_client in pubspec.yaml, and re-resolve dependencies so pubspec.lock no longer contains it.

verification.purpose: Re-resolve dependencies after replacing the package.
Analyze and test a Dart package on the replacement client.
Analyze and test a Flutter app on the replacement client.
